channel.title: Open Public Opportunities
channel.description: The Open Public Opportinities rss feed contains all opportunities for this organization that are visible through the public portal.

item.title: Reference #: RFP-LIT-001. Name: K-12 Literacy Curriculum and Assessment Platform
item.description: Description: Dallas ISD is seeking proposals for a comprehensive K-12 literacy curriculum, phonics intervention, and reading assessment platform for districtwide use. Vendors must demonstrate evidence-based outcomes. Project closes Jul 15, 2026 2:00 PM CDT.

item.title: Reference #: RFP-002. Name: Office Furniture and Fixtures
item.description: Description: Dallas ISD is seeking proposals for office furniture and fixtures for administrative buildings districtwide. Project closes Aug 01, 2026 2:00 PM CDT.

item.title: Reference #: RFP-TUT-003. Name: Tutoring Services for Struggling Readers
item.description: Description: Dallas ISD invites proposals for evidence-based tutoring services targeting students with dyslexia and reading intervention needs. Project closes Jul 20, 2026 2:00 PM CDT.
